messages:
incidentbot: Pager triggered for org=bluejar — sustained error rate 15%, 5xx spike, incoming 1200 rps, many 429s on /api/v1/generate. Impact: user sign-in flows failing. https://internal/evt/3067894321
oncall-alex: I'm on it. Seeing org bluejar at ~1.2k rps, org-level RL tripping (quota=300 qps). A lot of retries stacking, backpressure to auth service.
sre-lee: If we don't act they'll keep getting 429s and increased latency. Proposal: temporary org QPS bump to 1200 for 20m + disable the embed+rerank route for bluejar to shed expensive ops. Need eng-runtime ok for pool capacity.
eng-runtime-jay: We have spare slots on pool-gpu-west-1 (est headroom ~2x). I agree with temporary bump + route disable. Suggested commands:```
rctl org update --org bluejar --qps 1200 --ttl 20m --reason "prod spike mitigation"
rctl route disable --org bluejar --route /api/v1/embeds --reason "reduce heavy load"
```Risk: brief cost spike and if other orgs surge we may need to throttle elsewhere.
oncall-alex: executing now (running both commands)
deploy-bot: executed by oncall-alex at 3067894330: `rctl org update --org bluejar --qps 1200 --ttl 20m --reason "prod spike mitigation"` — SUCCESS
deploy-bot: executed by oncall-alex at 3067894331: `rctl route disable --org bluejar --route /api/v1/embeds --reason "reduce heavy load"` — SUCCESS
oncall-alex: bump + embed disable in place. Watching errors and tail latencies.
sre-lee: errors dropping — 5xx down from 15% -> 1.8% in last 2m. 429 counts for sign-in down to near-zero. Looks effective. Recommend hold 15m then ramp back to avoid oscillation.
cs-kate: I'll notify BlueJar AM and CS that we applied a temporary QPS increase and disabled embeds for 20m to stabilize sign-ins. Will provide ETA to restore and offer follow-up call.
pm-ravi: Please capture cost delta and add a quick runbook item: prefer graceful degradation by rejecting embed/rerank for noisy clients before org-level bump. We should also look at more granular route-based quotas.
oncall-alex: noted. Revert command (manual) if needed: `rctl org update --org bluejar --qps 300 --reason revert-to-config` — I'll schedule revert at 3067894440 unless we see renewed issues.
incidentbot: Incident note pinned: mitigation applied (temp org QPS 1200 / embed route disabled). Impact: sign-in flow mitigated. Started 3067894330. Assigned: oncall-alex, sre-lee, cs-kate. Monitoring continues.
cs-kate: Customer notified, they confirmed sign-in is back for majority of users. Asking for post-incident summary.
sre-lee: action items: 1) add per-route fallback for embed-heavy requests 2) add alert to detect org-specific rerank storms 3) run cost/impact analysis for QPS bumps. I'll create tickets after this.
oncall-alex: will close thread after revert window if stable. thanks all :thumbsup:
